moodEdits.prompt: Edit the exact isolated game creature sprite. Preserve its identity, colors, proportions, fur, materials, rendering, pose, transparent background, framing and accessories. Change only its expression and ear posture: gently sad and a little droopy, soft concerned eyebrows, smaller wistful downturned mouth, lovable bright eyes, slightly lowered ears. A friendly pet waiting for care, never distressed or crying. No tears, text, floor, or additional objects. Keep full character visible with transparent padding.
moodEdits.input: Corresponding starter creature asset in app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/
